credentials.description: Use the Edulink username and password you use on the website or app.

learners.title: Choose children
learners.description: Each child is added as a separate device.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate integration
reauth_confirm.description: Edulink rejected the saved credentials. Enter them again.

error.school_not_found: No school found for that code or postcode.
error.no_learners: No children are linked to this account, or none were selected.

abort.sso_only: This school only allows Microsoft sign-in, which this integration does not support.
abort.wrong_account: These credentials belong to a different Edulink account.

data.catering_interval: Catering update interval during the school day

data_description.catering_interval: Outside 07:30 to 16:00 on weekdays catering updates every 2 hours.
data_description.homework_interval: Between 22:00 and 06:00 homework updates every 2 hours.
data_description.homework_days_ahead: The outstanding homework sensor only counts homework due within this many days. The due today, due tomorrow and next due sensors, the to-do list and the calendar include all homework.
data_description.kit_rules: One rule per line, as subject keyword = item, for example Physical Education = PE kit. A keyword matches whole words in the lesson's subject, ignoring case.
data_description.academic_year_start_month: Achievement points and behaviour events this year count from the 1st of this month (9 is September).

error.invalid_kit_rules: Each line needs a subject keyword and an item, separated by =

homework_not_found.message: This homework is no longer in Edulink's current list.

homework_only_status.message: Only the done status of homework can be changed.

homework_update_failed.message: Edulink did not accept the change: {error}
